title: Plan work with explicit dependencies
statement: As a product manager, I can organize work into ordered waves with explicit dependency gates so contributors can see what can start and why blocked work must wait.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Queries expose the ordered wave list and each work item’s assigned wave.
Each dependency names a prerequisite item, a dependent item, and exactly one gate: completed progress, integrated required merges, or fulfillment of a specific contract revision.
For every unmet dependency, readiness identifies the blocking dependency and the unsatisfied or conflicted fact.
With no unmet explicit dependency, a work item remains ready regardless of incomplete work in an earlier wave.
An attempt to add a dependency that would create a cycle is rejected without publishing the dependency.
